searchText: if there's a EIP changing execution layer for merge, in blocks after whatever threshold is set for the merge, the pow clients could be coded to set the blockreward=rand(), so there is no POW consensus possible after the merge threshold (so those who want an eth1 new-classic would have to explicitly agree a new reward threshold)
